scores.evidence: At 390 px the s1-lifecycle flowchart TD is readable, with Japanese labels and no clipped nodes (mobile-jp-04, desktop-jp-03). All tables (s3-table, s4-scopes, s5-checks, practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b) fit without sideways scrolling. Two bash blocks the learner types or copies lose their key line ends at 390 px: s2-script line 8 `>&2` (mobile-jp-08) and practice-model-script lines 5 and 12 (mobile-jp-22).

No screen is text-only (textOnlyScreens empty on desktop and mobile). Each section breaks up its text with a definitions block, code, a table or a check. The weakest spots are the long bold scenario in the practice-b-quiz q9 prompt (6 to 7 lines, mobile-jp-23/24, desktop-jp-17) and the run of three code blocks in a row in practice (mobile-jp-21 to 23).

This is a Japanese-only lesson. Diagram labels, captions and quiz text are all in Japanese, with English terms only in glosses such as フック（hook）. Line breaks inside Japanese words look natural. The only weak spot is the prerequisites line, which is long and set in small grey type (mobile-jp-01, desktop-jp-01). Desktop median charsPerLine is 44, above the 30–40 target.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px, line 8 `echo "Blocked: rm is not allowed" >&2` is cut at the right edge, so only `>&` shows. The `>&2` is what this example teaches: the reason goes to stderr. The highlighted lines 7–9 are the core of the example.
mustFix.fix: Wrap line 8 the same way as practice-model-script, e.g. `  echo "Blocked: rm is not allowed" \` then `    >&2`, or shorten the message to `echo "Blocked: rm" >&2`, so that every line is 36 characters or fewer.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px, the ends of highlighted line 5 (`jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')`, cut at `empt`) and highlighted line 12 (`if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *"$pat"* ]]; then`, `then` cut off) are hidden in the model answer that learners compare their script against.
mustFix.fix: Keep every line at 36 characters or fewer. For example, split line 5 as `  jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' \` + `    '// empty')`, or shorten it by dropping `// empty`. Split line 12 into `  if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *"$pat"* ]]` and `  then`, or rename `FILE_PATH` to `FP`.

niceToHave: s1-prettier: line 9 (the `command` string) is cut off on desktop as well as at 390 px (desktop-jp-04, mobile-jp-05). The prose in s1-config repeats the whole command, so nothing is lost. Optionally add a note under the code ('9行目のコマンドは上の文と同じです').

s2-settings / practice-model-settings: the `command` lines (9, 18) run past the right edge at 390 px (mobile-jp-09, mobile-jp-23). The path is repeated in prose in s2-steps and practice-model-intro, so this is acceptable. A JSON string cannot wrap.
s2-test: at 390 px the colon after `"tool_input"` on line 5 is just past the edge (mobile-jp-10). Moving `"tool_input":` onto line 6 would make it fit fully.

s4-add: at 390 px, line 2 loses its trailing `\` and line 6 loses `<起動コマンド>` (mobile-jp-15). Shortening the comment on line 6 (for example `# claude mcp add <名前> -- <コマンド>`) and breaking line 2 before `http notion` would keep the continuation visible.

practice-b-quiz: the q9 prompt is a 6–7 line bold paragraph (mobile-jp-23/24). Moving the A/B scenario into the practice-b-task markdown (or a two-row table) and keeping only the question in the prompt would ease reading.
lesson: the prerequisites line under the subtitle is a long run of small grey text (mobile-jp-01). Fewer or shorter prerequisites would read better.
reader: desktop charsPerLine median is 44, above the JP target of 30–40 (measure 680 px). This is a reader layout setting, not lesson content.
reader: code blocks give no cue that they scroll sideways at 390 px (known behaviour).
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (known behaviour).
summary: metrics.json shows no hard failures (overflowX false, 0 console/mermaid/unknown/broken), no text-only screens, and no personal data on any screen. The flowchart and all tables read well at 390 px. Two bash blocks (s2-script, practice-model-script) lose key line ends at 390 px, including the `>&2` the example teaches. Wrapping those lines is the main fix.
